entries.title: Logan Beats Himself, Joe Beats Himself, Everyone's a Winner (and a Loser)
entries.subtitle: A night of glorious civil wars as the leaderboard's top two swap thrones over a single point
entries.html:
And lo, on the Night of Thursday 25 June, the football gods grew bored of ordinary fixtures and decreed that men should be made to play against their own reflections, that brothers should be made to gnash teeth, and that one Pete should be made to sit, stone-faced, gaining precisely nothing. Gather round; it was a night of self-harm conducted at international level.

Group E — Logan's House of Mirrors

In the most psychologically deranged fixture of the tournament, Ecuador 🇪🇨 beat Germany 🇩🇪 2-1 — and both were owned by Logan, the poor lamb left applauding one hand whilst the other clutched his chest. Germany still strolls through top of the group, qualified and serene; Ecuador finishes third and now begins the agonising best-third vigil, lighting candles and refreshing the table like a man waiting on biopsy results. Meanwhile Curaçao 🇨🇼 — Barney's gallant tier-eight no-hopers — were dispatched 0-2 by Joe's Ivory Coast 🇨🇮, who march into the knockouts in second and seize the summit of League 4, deposing Barney's Canada in the process. Barney giveth, Barney taketh away.

Group F — The Joe Civil War

Then the truly biblical bit. Joe owns three-quarters of Group F, and so Joe spent the small hours playing himself like a man arm-wrestling his own dominant hand. Tunisia 🇹🇳 — winless, gutless, shipping twelve goals like a colander auditioning for a sieve — were put to the sword 1-3 by Joe's own Netherlands 🇳🇱, who finish top and gloriously qualified. Joe's Sweden 🇸🇪 could only draw 1-1 with Logan's Japan 🇯🇵; Japan sail through second, while Sweden join the third-place lottery, sweating it out alongside Ecuador. Seven sweepstake points harvested by Joe in one night — the night's biggest haul — and yet, such is the comedy of his draft, much of it was simply Joe robbing Joe.

Group D — Sean's Beautiful, Pointless Triumph

Geo's Australia 🇦🇺 ground out a goalless draw with Barney's Paraguay 🇵🇾, enough to drag the Socceroos into second and qualification, whilst Paraguay slides into third and the customary nail-biting wait. And in the night's most magnificently futile act of defiance, Sean's Turkey 🇹🇷 beat Pete's United States 🇺🇸 3-2 — a thumping, heroic, blood-and-thunder win that achieved absolutely sod all, Turkey going out regardless and the already-top USA qualifying anyway. Sean got three points for his trophy cabinet; Pete got the indignity, and nothing else, on a night he gained a flat, funereal zero.

The Reckoning

The headline at the top of the £60 pot: Logan, who walked in second on 32, leaves it top on 36 — vaulting clean over Geo, who came in leading on 35 and managed a measly single point, watching his crown lifted whilst he wasn't looking. They're level on 36 but Logan holds the throne. Joe's seven-point bonanza was the night's loudest, yet leaves him stranded in fourth, the man who won everything and climbed nothing. Sean nudged up to 22 in fifth; Barney holds third by a thread; and poor Pete props up the lot, gaining nought whilst his Turkey-slaying tormentor toasted a meaningless win. Mexico still rules League 1 for Geo — small comfort for a man dethroned in the only league that pays.

entries.title: Geo Conquers, Qatar Crumbles, and Pete Plumbs the Haitian Depths
entries.subtitle: A night the Thomas TwoShell empire ate itself in Group A — and still came out smelling of roses
entries.html:
Lo, on the Night of Wednesday 24 June the heavens opened and rained nine sweepstake points upon the chosen, while the wretched were left to gnash their teeth in the away end — and nobody, but nobody, gnashed harder than Pete.

Group B — Switzerland take it, Geo eats himself again

🇨🇭 Switzerland did exactly what Switzerland do, settling 🇨🇦 Canada 2-1 with the cold efficiency of a numbered bank account, topping the group on seven and handing Geo a tidy haul. Spare a thought, then, for Barney, whose Canada still squeak through in second yet contributed the grand sum of sod all to his evening. Meanwhile 🇧🇦 Bosnia-Herzegovina battered 🇶🇦 Qatar 3-1 — Logan's underdogs feasting on Geo's other lamb. Qatar, with two goals for and TEN against, depart the tournament looking like they wandered into the wrong stadium and apologised the whole way through.

Group C — Brazil purr, Scotland perish, Pete's Haitian horror

🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 Scotland were taken behind the bike sheds by 🇧🇷 Brazil, 0-3, and Sean's Tartan Army now sit third, biting their nails through the best-third lottery like a man waiting on a hospital scan. Brazil cruise. And in the night's true bloodbath, 🇲🇦 Morocco put four past 🇭🇹 Haiti, Logan banking yet more while Pete's Haiti slunk off with played three, lost three, nil points — a campaign of such unrelenting calamity it deserves its own Netflix documentary and a grief counsellor.

Group A — the house of Thomas TwoShell devours its own

Here, dear watcher, was farce of the highest order. 🇲🇽 Mexico dismantled Logan's 🇨🇿 Czechia 0-3 to finish a flawless nine points, knocking Germany off the summit of League 1 in the process. Then came the fixture for the philosophers: 🇿🇦 South Africa 1-0 🇰🇷 South Korea — Geo versus Geo, a man arm-wrestling himself in the mirror and somehow losing one hand. South Africa qualify second, South Korea wobble into third, and Geo simply shrugged, having owned every single boot on the pitch.

The Reckoning

And so to the ledger. Geo banked NINE points, vaulting from second to top of the £60 player league on 35, and now leads Leagues 1, 2 and 3 through Mexico and Switzerland — an emperor surveying his realm even as Qatar and South Korea bleed out at his feet. Logan matched him point for point, also +9, climbing third to second on 32 and crowning Bosnia atop League 7. The cruellest twist belongs to Barney, who walked in leading the whole thing and walked out third, undone not by his own teams but by the sheer relentlessness of the two men above him. Joe (a stationary fourth) and Sean (fifth) merely watched. And Pete? Pete props up the table on 16, the proud owner of the only side on the planet to lose all three, a man whose World Cup is now purely spectatorial. On the night: Geo and Logan feasted. In the tables: Geo is king. Long may he reign — until tomorrow, when football, as ever, comes for everybody.
